Talanoa is your first email messenger. It turns messy email threads into clean, chat-like conversations, removing quotes, signatures and clutter along the way. Turn emails into actionable todos, manage your calendar without leaving your inbox, and use private, on-device AI to search, summarize and write. Launch tags:Email•Productivity•Task Management [...] to the reply. Yet email clients still show repeated quotes, signatures, headers, footers and years of clutter. So I rebuilt Talanoa around a different idea: what if email felt more like a messenger? Today, Talanoa turns your inbox into clean, chat-like conversations, while keeping everything that makes email, email. But it goes further: 💬 Emails become actual conversations ✅ Any email can become a todo with a next step and due date 📅 Your calendar lives alongside your conversations ✨ AI helps you search, summarize and write, entirely on-device 📥 Gmail, Outlook, iCloud and IMAP accounts can live in one inbox 🔒 No cloud sync, no tracking. Your emails stay on your computer. I’ve been building Talanoa independently, talking to users, breaking things, rebuilding them, and questioning quite a [...] breaking things, rebuilding them, and questioning quite a few assumptions we’ve had about email for the last 30 years. What started as a tool I built for myself has slowly become something much bigger, and this version finally feels like the Talanoa I always wanted to use. I’d genuinely love your feedback, especially on one thing: Does the “email as a conversation” approach change the way you feel about your inbox? And if there’s one thing your current email client does that you couldn’t live without, tell me. I’m listening 👇 Thanks for checking out Talanoa ❤️ John
